name: network_baseline
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk network baseline (VPC, subnets, NAT gateways).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this network baseline.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the network baseline.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Provisioning mode: Create (the platform provisions a new VPC) or Import (adopt an existing VPC not provisioned by the platform — set vpc_id to the VPC to adopt). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Cloud region (e.g. us-east-1).

attributes.name: cloud
attributes.description: Cloud provider the network is provisioned in. Valid values: Aws, Azure, Gcp, K8S_ONLY. Immutable after creation. Defaults to Aws.

attributes.name: cidr
attributes.description: VPC CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16). Required when the platform provisions a new VPC; leave unset when importing an existing VPC (vpc_id) — it is read from the imported VPC.

attributes.name: az_count
attributes.description: Number of availability zones (1-4).

attributes.name: subnet_prefix
attributes.description: Subnet prefix length (e.g. 24).

attributes.name: nat_mode
attributes.description: NAT gateway mode: None, SingleAz, or MultiAz.

attributes.name: enable_dns
attributes.description: Enable DNS support in the VPC.

attributes.name: enable_flow_logs
attributes.description: Enable VPC flow logs.

attributes.name: flow_logs_retention_days
attributes.description: Flow logs retention in days. Required when enable_flow_logs is true; when unset the server assigns the value (computed, no static default).

attributes.name: env_tag
attributes.description: Environment tag applied to provisioned resources.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this network to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: UUID of this network baseline, for reference by dependent resources (e.g. a cluster baseline).

attributes.name: vpc_id
attributes.description: ID of the VPC. Set this to import an existing VPC that was not provisioned by the platform (the baseline adopts the given VPC instead of creating one); leave unset to have the platform provision a new VPC. Computed to the provisioned or adopted VPC ID.

attributes.name: subnet_ids
attributes.description: Provisioned subnet IDs.

attributes.name: nat_gateway_ids
attributes.description: Provisioned NAT gateway IDs.
